last_rtf.note: server-side worker RTF samples (elapsed/inference-audio-duration) taken only while actual_mode == requested cpu/npu mode; empty for passthrough or when a worker was never engaged

thermal_summary.note: thermal data is advisory evidence from the board OS; it is not a verdict criterion by itself, but a PASS without thermal data means throttling was not observable during the soak.
